description: Will my paid API get listed? Audits any x402 endpoint URL: runs the readiness check, flags the 500 character description limit, then checks the Coinbase Bazaar listing, OpenAPI x-payment-info, 402 Index entry, favicon, llms.txt and /.well-known/x402. Returns a 0-100 score, verdict and an ordered fix list. Never sends a payment. Price $0.01 USDC per call via x402.
